body.name: Composite-null rank-margin separation radius
body.construction: \(\rho_n^\ast=\inf\{\rho>0:\exists\,\psi\text{ measurable with }\sup_{\mathbf P\in\mathcal M_s:\gamma_{pq}\le0}\mathbb P_{\mathbf P}(\psi=1)\le0.05\text{ and }\sup_{\mathbf P\in\mathcal M_s:\gamma_{pq}\ge\rho}\mathbb P_{\mathbf P}(\psi=0)\le0.20\}\).
